jvmParams.enabled.title: Enable JVM Default Parameters
jvmParams.enabled.description: Master switch. When off, no configuration is contributed and no file is patched.

jvmParams.vmOptions.title: VM options
jvmParams.vmOptions.description: The JVM options injected into every configuration, on one line, quoted runs allowed, for example: -Xmx2g -Xms512m -XX:+UseG1GC -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8

jvmParams.programArgs.title: Program arguments
jvmParams.programArgs.description: The application arguments injected into every configuration, on one line, for example: --server.port=8081 --spring.profiles.active=dev

jvmParams.springProfiles.title: Spring profiles
jvmParams.springProfiles.description: Comma separated profiles, injected as -Dspring.profiles.active=… before your VM options are merged.

jvmParams.mode.title: Merge mode
jvmParams.mode.description: append keeps every value a run configuration already sets and only fills the gaps; override replaces a value that uses the same JVM switch. Both keep the order the configuration already has.

jvmParams.javaExecutable.title: java executable
jvmParams.javaExecutable.description: Program used to launch a jar. Keep 'java' to let the IDE resolve it on PATH and approve it once; an absolute path cannot be approved for a contributed configuration and would hide the jar configurations.

jvmParams.platform.title: Platform
jvmParams.platform.description: Which wrapper flavor to plan for. 'auto' reads it from the project path, which is the only signal a sandboxed plugin has.

jvmParams.mavenProgram.title: Maven program override
jvmParams.mavenProgram.description: Leave empty to use the project's mvnw.cmd / mvnw wrapper. Set a bare program name such as mvn to use a global Maven instead; the name must be one the plugin declares, so the IDE can approve it.

jvmParams.gradleProgram.title: Gradle program override
jvmParams.gradleProgram.description: Leave empty to use the project's gradlew.bat / gradlew wrapper, or set a bare name such as gradle.

jvmParams.jarSearchDirs.title: Extra jar directories
jvmParams.jarSearchDirs.description: Directories searched for a runnable jar in addition to target and build/libs, relative to each module.

jvmParams.provider.enabled.title: Contribute run configurations
jvmParams.provider.enabled.description: Offer generated configurations in the Run dialog. Turn off to only use the file patching command.

jvmParams.provider.bootJar.title: java -jar configurations
jvmParams.provider.bootJar.description: Contribute a configuration that runs the module's jar with your VM options. Only possible when the jar is visible to the plugin.

jvmParams.provider.springBootMaven.title: Maven spring-boot:run configurations
jvmParams.provider.springBootMaven.description: Contribute wrapper configurations that pass your VM options as -Dspring-boot.run.jvmArguments and your program arguments as -Dspring-boot.run.arguments.

jvmParams.provider.springBootGradle.title: Gradle bootRun configurations
jvmParams.provider.springBootGradle.description: Contribute gradlew bootRun configurations. Gradle only takes program arguments from the command line, so these carry your program arguments and say so in their name.

jvmParams.provider.emitAllStrategies.title: Every applicable strategy
jvmParams.provider.emitAllStrategies.description: Contribute every strategy a module supports instead of the first applicable one.

jvmParams.provider.maxConfigurations.title: Maximum configurations
jvmParams.provider.maxConfigurations.description: Upper bound on the configurations contributed for one project.
